current_evidence: The council's 'Submit a planning application' page (last updated 24 April 2026) links this matrix, whose text is dated April 2026, together with Validation checklist V11 (March 2025) and the Matrix Key (February 2025).

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 3 items, all taken from web-page text, and none of the 22 rows in the matrix. Missing: UU/Section 106 agreement (residential 10+ units); Affordable Housing Statement (20+ units); Air Quality Assessment; Biodiversity survey/ecological report (by a suitably qualified ecologist); Environmental Statement (Schedule 1/2 EIA development); Town Centre Impact Assessment and Sequential Test (town-centre retail/commercial); Flood Risk Assessment/Drainage (SuDS); Site Archaeological Evaluation; Preliminary Risk Assessment (contaminated land); Noise Impact Assessment; Open Space Assessment; Structural Survey and Method Statement (listed buildings/demolition); Transport Assessment; Green Travel Plan; Tree survey/planting plan/landscape appraisal; Sustainability Statement (Sustainability SPD 2024); Daylight and Sunlight test; External Lighting Survey; Waste Management Details (refuse/recycling storage and swept path); Statutory Biodiversity Metric; Energy Statement (Sustainability SPD 2024); Statement of Community Involvement. The matrix assigns each to columns (Householder, Listed buildings, Conservation area, Residential 1-9 / 10+ / 50+, Commercial/Retail town centre and non-town centre, Infrastructure, EIA Sch1/Sch2, Telecoms) using Required / most / some circumstances codes.
issues.evidence: Matrix 'Explanatory matrix to accompany standard application forms', April 2026; Matrix Key Feb 2025 lists items 1-22

issues.detail: Local items in Validation checklist V11 (March 2025) are not captured. These are: the statutory BNG metric for major or minor development, in Excel and PDF; a draft Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan where there are significant on-site enhancements; BNG exemption justification; the 1:500 block plan showing window positions, trees, materials, access/parking, boundary treatment and street scene; existing and proposed roof plans for all applications; and a covering letter for all applications.
issues.evidence: Validation checklist V11: '1:500 block plan ... All applications'; 'Roof plan - existing and proposed'

issues.detail: The council's flood form for householder and other minor extensions in Flood Zones 2 and 3 appears only as link text inside a 'Submission rules' item. It is not recorded as a Householder requirement, and Householder shows '(none)', even though the matrix has a Householder column with requirements.
issues.evidence: Submit page: 'Householder and other minor extensions in Flood Zone 2 and 3 form'

issues.detail: All application types other than Full planning are recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', and BNG is filed under Full planning as 'INFERRED'. The matrix sets requirements for Householder, listed building works and demolition, conservation area, residential bands, commercial/retail, infrastructure, EIA and telecoms columns.

All 4 tab items are web-page link text with file sizes, such as 'Validation checklist pdf, 145.06 KB Matrix Council validation requirements pdf, 292.01 KB...' and 'Paper copies of the form can be downloaded from Planning Portal'. They are not requirements.

The trigger excerpts start with file-size fragments ('531.39 KB', '571.02 KB'). The Self-build/custom build row uses the Design and Access Statement text as its trigger. The Self/Custom Build item is really a BNG exemption form for self-build applications claiming the exemption. The DAS trigger is cut off at 'designated area, i.e.'.
issues.evidence: Self-build row trigger: 'Self Build and Custom Build BNG exemption form pdf , 571.02 KB Design and access statements ... designated area, i.e.'

issues.detail: The List date 2026-04-01 comes from the URL upload month. The document text says 'April 2026' with no day, so the date is right in substance but the day is invented.

summary: Grokbot's link is to the current April 2026 validation matrix, but it extracted almost nothing from it: 3 web-page fragments against the matrix's 22 local requirements and the local items in checklist V11. Every application type except Full planning is wrongly shown as having no local requirements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
